# AMMIGE

> AMMIGE is a premium women's handbags brand from Pakistan (founded 2026).
> Everyday, Signature and Leather collections. Prices in PKR. Cash on Delivery
> available nationwide across Pakistan. 7-day easy exchange. Premium gift
> packaging on every order. WhatsApp: +92 316 2852167.

## Brand facts
- Name: AMMIGE — tagline "Carry Grace Everywhere"
- What: handcrafted women's handbags — Everyday, Signature and Leather collections
- Market: Pakistan, online-only store
- Currency: PKR (Pakistani Rupee); all prices shown as "Rs X,XXX"
- Payment: Cash on Delivery (COD) nationwide; bank transfer also accepted
- Delivery: 2–4 working days via TCS / Leopards / PostEx; flat Rs 250 shipping, FREE on orders over Rs 5,000
- Returns: 7-day easy exchange on unused items
